# files=9 commands=66

=== luo:math/comptime ===
scoreboard players set #math.-1 math -1
scoreboard players set #math.0 math 0
scoreboard players set #math.1 math 1
scoreboard players set #math.2 math 2
scoreboard players set #math.3 math 3
=== luo:math/init ===
scoreboard objectives add a0 dummy cmcf
scoreboard objectives add l2 dummy cmcf
scoreboard objectives add l3 dummy cmcf
scoreboard objectives add l4 dummy cmcf
scoreboard objectives add l5 dummy cmcf
scoreboard objectives add l9 dummy cmcf
scoreboard objectives add math dummy cmcf
scoreboard objectives add return dummy cmcf
scoreboard objectives add t0 dummy cmcf
scoreboard objectives add t1 dummy cmcf
scoreboard objectives add t2 dummy cmcf
scoreboard objectives add t3 dummy cmcf
scoreboard objectives add cmcf.c dummy cmcf
scoreboard players set #2 cmcf.c 2
scoreboard players set #4 cmcf.c 4
scoreboard players set #1234 cmcf.c 1234
scoreboard players set #67108864 cmcf.c 67108864
scoreboard players set #1103515245 cmcf.c 1103515245
=== luo:math/is_happen_fix1000 ===
scoreboard players operation @s l5 = seed math
scoreboard players operation @s l5 *= #1103515245 cmcf.c
scoreboard players operation @s l5 += #1234 cmcf.c
scoreboard players operation @s l5 %= #67108864 cmcf.c
scoreboard players set @s l9 1000
scoreboard players operation @s t2 = @s l5
scoreboard players operation @s t2 -= @s a0
scoreboard players set @s t3 0
execute @s[score_t2=0] ~ ~ ~ scoreboard players set @s t3 1
scoreboard players operation @s return = @s t3
=== luo:math/lcg_step ===
scoreboard players operation @s return = #1103515245 cmcf.c
scoreboard players operation @s return *= @s a0
scoreboard players operation @s return += #1234 cmcf.c
scoreboard players operation @s return %= #67108864 cmcf.c
=== luo:math/load ===
scoreboard players set seed math 12345
=== luo:math/sqrt ===
scoreboard players operation @s t0 = @s a0
scoreboard players operation @s t0 -= #4 cmcf.c
execute @s[score_t0=-1] ~ ~ ~ scoreboard players set @s return 1
execute @s[score_t0_min=0] ~ ~ ~ function luo:math/sqrt$b2
=== luo:math/sqrt$b2 ===
scoreboard players operation @s l2 = @s a0
scoreboard players operation @s l2 /= #4 cmcf.c
scoreboard players set @s l3 0
scoreboard players set @s l4 32
scoreboard players operation @s t0 = @s l2
scoreboard players operation @s t0 -= @s l3
execute @s[score_t0=-1] ~ ~ ~ function luo:math/sqrt$b3
execute @s[score_t0_min=1] ~ ~ ~ function luo:math/sqrt$b3
execute @s[score_t0_min=0,score_t0=0] ~ ~ ~ function luo:math/sqrt$b4
=== luo:math/sqrt$b3 ===
scoreboard players operation @s l3 = @s l2
scoreboard players operation @s t0 = @s a0
scoreboard players operation @s t0 /= @s l2
scoreboard players operation @s t1 = @s l2
scoreboard players operation @s t1 += @s t0
scoreboard players operation @s l2 = @s t1
scoreboard players operation @s l2 /= #2 cmcf.c
scoreboard players operation @s t0 = @s l2
scoreboard players operation @s t0 -= @s l3
scoreboard players remove @s l4 1
execute @s[score_l4_min=1,score_t0=-1] ~ ~ ~ function luo:math/sqrt$b3
execute @s[score_l4_min=1,score_t0_min=1] ~ ~ ~ function luo:math/sqrt$b3
execute @s[score_l4=0] ~ ~ ~ function luo:math/sqrt$b4
execute @s[score_t0_min=0,score_t0=0] ~ ~ ~ function luo:math/sqrt$b4
=== luo:math/sqrt$b4 ===
scoreboard players operation @s return = @s l2
